firstPlayerRule: The player whose visit to Portugal was most recent starts.
houseFallback: If no one qualifies or your group cannot agree, you can agree to pick randomly. This is an optional house rule, not an official Azul tie-break.
clarifications: Before the first turn, the starting player puts the marker in the center. Turns then proceed clockwise.
The floor-line penalty is separate: the first player to select tiles from the center also takes the marker and puts it on their floor line.
